apparatus.note: The original printed marginal apparatus includes alternatives for “handling aright the word of truth,” including “rightly dividing the word of truth.”
The original 1901 translation note offers “Every scripture is inspired of God, and profitable” as an alternative to the printed main-text rendering.

scope_note: Selected major original 1901 marginal notes, supplemented by all original scanned printed apparatus and byte-preserved original digital USX notes; not a modern textual-critical reconstruction.
